claim_ceiling: Evaluation infrastructure executes and discriminates on real corpus data. Two strong baselines established: TF-IDF reasoning-only (fails all legal-quality metrics: boilerplate resistance 0.01, multilingual separation -0.24, hierarchy NMI 0.03, citation proximity AUC 0.64) and sentence-transformers multilingual (passes corpus stability, improves legal-area purity 0.88, hierarchy NMI 0.067, multilingual separation -0.06; fails citation proximity AUC 0.50, neighbor relevance AUC 0.58). Legal-distance lane must beat both baselines on citation proximity (>0.75), multilingual separation (>0.1), legal-area NMI (>0.3), and neighbor relevance (>0.95). Boilerplate resistance untested for neural baseline.
